title: JUNK!
text: JUNK!. If we ever go to war with China, the factory that produces these will be the first we level...if I have anything to say about it! Apparently the the shaft that connects the "gear-wheel" to the twist-knob is constructed of plastic...and eventually snaps. Stay Away, as you would from an STD!
